heading: About beekeeper
description: beekeeper reads the session files Claude Code writes under ~/.claude/projects (or the projects folder under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR when it's set) and shows what each agent did, changed, and cost.
promise: It runs entirely on your computer. It makes no network requests, sends no telemetry, and never writes to ~/.claude or to your repositories.
